important_semantics.validation_not_cleaning: The platform validates data and produces flags/candidates according to the frozen V1 rules. It does NOT automatically modify, clean, or delete source records. Any cleaning requires explicit authorization outside the validation engine.
important_semantics.assessability_not_cleanliness: A flag value of 0 does not always mean the data is clean. geography_mismatch_candidate=0 when zip_state_assessable=0 means NOT ASSESSABLE (not clean). email_syntax_failure=0 when email_blank=1 means blank (not syntax-valid). Always check assessability flags before interpreting defect flags.
important_semantics.pass_not_perfect_data: A final verdict of PASS means the validation process completed and all applicable checks were satisfied. It does NOT mean every source record is clean, every flagged record is a business error, or customer data has been cleaned. PASS means the PROCESS worked correctly; the DATA may still require human review.

data_contract.output_column_order: OUTPUT_COLUMNS = SOURCE_COLUMNS + FLAG_COLUMNS (33 source columns first, then 8 flag columns)
data_contract.row_preservation: Validation does not silently remove rows. The engine writes exactly one output row per input row.
